summary.summary: At 07:39 and 07:41 UTC on 2026-01-21, the sshd service generated two high‑severity brute‑force alerts from the same source IP (ip_f4c39653e4d8). The first alert recorded 10 failed login attempts to the root account within 5 minutes, meeting its threshold. The second alert recorded 30 failed attempts across multiple accounts in the same 5‑minute window, also meeting its threshold. This volume of failed logins is unusual compared with normal ssh traffic.
summary.likely_trigger: A rapid series of failed SSH login attempts from a single IP, consistent with a credential‑guessing attack (MITRE ATT&CK T1110/T1110.001).
summary.suggested_next_check: Examine the sshd logs for any successful logins from ip_f4c39653e4d8 and consider blocking or rate‑limiting that IP.
